notes: Fix 2026-10-15 by claude (24ba982c81): No code change. Unity's own editor state file (Library/StateCache/LayerSettings) was locked by another process: a second Unity instance or Multiplayer Play Mode clone on the same project, antivirus or a cloud-sync folder. Not game code. Closes if it does not recur; if it does, keep B:/FrogletGames out of OneDrive/antivirus scanning.
